name: Dr. Josh Pauli
biography: is an Associate Professor of Information Assurance at Dakota State University in Madison, SD where he teaches graduate and undergraduate courses in web and software security. His background is in software engineering and information systems. Dr. Pauli first attended DEF CON 16 (friggin' n00b) and was hooked immediately - he has spent every waking moment since then trying to figure out how to inject DEF CON into DSU's security program and bring his students to DEF CON 19 and beyond!
